title: Fallback decision telemetry canvas for multi-region circuit health and token-shed reasoning
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Instrument the decision path that leads to region failover, circuit tripping, and token-level load shed; expose the decision telemetry as a reusable Grafana canvas and a set of SLI derivations. Goal: make it trivial for oncall and SREs to diagnose WHY traffic was routed/fallbacked/shed at the token level and to track regressions in fallback correctness over time.
tasks: Design event schema for fallback decisions and attach to request trace: fields include decision_id, policy_version, priority_score, region_ranking, circuit_state, kv_hit_ratio, kv_prefetch_hint, token_count, decision_timestamp
Add structured trace spans and tags at the routing layer and admission controller to capture pre-decision metrics (queue_size, current_latency_quantile, regional_capacity_pct)
Create SLI derivations: token-p99-by-decision-path, decision-frequency-by-policy, rollback-rate-after-fallback, regional-failover-latency-impact
Wire logs -> tracing -> metrics: implement a lightweight aggregator to emit decision telemetry to the metrics pipeline (Prometheus/OTLP), with a sampling policy for low-memory paths
Build Grafana canvas with panels: decision waterfall, policy fingerprint timeline, token-p99 split by decision branch, circuit health timeline, synthetic probe impact overlay
Add synthetic tests that exercise: KV-cache hit/miss, degraded-region latency, quota-exhaustion scenarios; hook tests to CI to prevent regressions
Document playbook entries for common scenarios: graceful fallback, noisy-degradation, policy bug, and false-positive shedding
Create acceptance tests and a rolling rollout plan for the telemetry with feature flag gating
acceptance_criteria: Decision telemetry schema published and agreed in design doc with SRE and Runtime teams
Routing and admission layers emit decision traces for >90% of requests in canary during UTC business hours
Grafana canvas deployed to observability namespace and added to oncall dashboard set
SLI derivations compute token-p99-by-decision-path and are available in dashboards and alerts
Synthetic tests detect and fail for a regression that masks fallback decisions (CI coverage)
